lines: Irving is getting more work lately: 21.7 carries per game over his last 3, up from 18.5 on the season.
Over his last 3 games he's averaging 22.8 PPR points and 111.7 rushing yards per game, with 9 total TDs this season.
Week 12 is against Carolina, which allows the 1st-most PPR points per game to RBs. Tampa's implied team total is 23.2 points.
